nodes.text: Select Heroic dungeon difficulty yourself, check today’s saved instance, and enter modern Scholomance. The rare does not spawn in Normal.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

destination.label: Modern Scholomance entrance
destination.directions: Enter Caer Darrow keep and use the ordinary dungeon portal, not Eva’s Enchanted Journal.

nodes.text: In the first classroom, defeat Instructor Chillheart. If her body falls but combat continues, destroy the phylactery and stay ahead of the advancing ice wall.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Follow the dungeon passage into the illusion room and defeat Jandice Barov. When she splits, find and damage the real Jandice; leave the dangerous ground effects.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Continue into the bone-filled chamber and defeat Rattlegore. Click a bone pile for Bone Armor if Bone Spike threatens you; avoid the blue Soulflame patches.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: After Rattlegore dies, enter the next room and check for Doctor Theolen Krastinov. His arrival yell announces a spawn; he is not detectable at the dungeon entrance.

recovery.text: If he is absent after Rattlegore, this run has no observed rare opportunity. Do not wait on a guessed respawn or reset a completed Heroic boss for another daily attempt. Use another eligible character or return after the observed reset.

nodes.text: If Krastinov appeared, defeat him and loot Krastinov’s Bag of Horrors. Check the corpse and bag space before leaving.

recovery.text: The rare spawn is uncertain. A Rattlegore kill, yell or Krastinov kill does not prove toy receipt; keep the goal open until the item or ownership is observed.

nodes.writtenDestination: Modern Scholomance: the room immediately beyond Rattlegore’s bone chamber; Krastinov appears here when this run has the rare spawn.

nodes.text: Use Krastinov’s Bag of Horrors from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.

instanceContext.opportunity: One Heroic instance reset opportunity per character; rare spawn not guaranteed.
instanceContext.resetEvidence: Use current game saved-instance reset time.

originalSourceFacts.description: The Familiar Journal itself can be found in the Viewing Room of Old Scholomance, on the second bookshelf from the left wall, near the mini-boss Marduk Blackpool. All you have to do is pick up the book, and the toy is yours! It's as simple as that.

recovery.text: Dark Rune is the tradable item 20520, not Demonic Rune. Auction prices are unknown until inspected; Toybox never buys or spends for you. Check bank storage for an existing unique Spectral Essence first.

nodes.text: Pass the Viewing Room and descend into Headmaster’s Retreat. Defeat Darkmaster Gandling. If Harsh Lesson teleports you away, clear the study-room enemies to return; dispelling a living subject can burst nearby undead.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: After Gandling, go to the upper central study room and stand by its bone pile. Use Krastinov’s Bag of Horrors, or have your companion use it there, to reveal Eva Sarkhoff. Remove the Surgical Alterations toy buff so she will speak to you.

recovery.text: The ordinary Caer Darrow ghost and the newly summoned dungeon Eva are different interactions. Check the upper room and bone pile, then remove the disguise. Continue only moves the cursor until her actual dialogue or item is observed.

nodes.text: Speak with the revealed Eva and exhaust her ritual dialogue. Receive Inert Spectral Essence if you do not already have Spectral Essence. Loot Eva’s Femur from the adjacent bones.

recovery.text: If no Inert Spectral Essence is offered, look for the existing unique trinket in bags or bank. Speak before trying to loot the femur; do not discard veteran items.

nodes.text: Before leaving, return to the Viewing Room. Walk behind the southwestern bookcase near the doorway and collect Eva’s Journal from its shelf.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Use Inert Spectral Essence with the three Dark Runes and five Essence of Undeath to restore Spectral Essence. Equip the restored trinket before looking for Caer Darrow’s ghosts.

recovery.text: Restoring consumes the listed materials and is a player action. If the trinket is already restored, equip it rather than making another. Inventory possession alone does not prove that it is equipped.

nodes.text: Collect the water bucket beside the fountain.

recovery.text: These ritual objects require Eva’s introduction. Keep the live ritual items; already exchanged items need not be collected again. If the object is absent, check Eva’s dialogue and whether the matching candle is already in bags.

recovery.text: If the ghost is invisible, equip Spectral Essence. Check the exact item and NPC; a trade consumes the memento. Do not infer it occurred from arrival.

nodes.text: Keep all five candles, Eva’s Journal and Eva’s Femur. In Caer Darrow keep, turn right instead of entering the modern dungeon portal; follow the corridor to the room with a floor grate and bones. Use Eva’s Journal to perform the ritual.

recovery.text: This room is outside the dungeon instance. Check all seven ritual items before using the journal. The ritual consumes them; the observed achievement/unlock, not Continue, establishes access.

destination.label: Ritual room in Caer Darrow keep

nodes.text: Click Eva’s Enchanted Journal on the ritual pedestal and choose to enter the Memory of Scholomance. If your account already unlocked it, begin directly here.

recovery.text: Use the book on the pedestal, not the ordinary blue dungeon portal. If it is absent, complete the ritual branch; an account achievement can support this specific account-wide unlock.

nodes.text: In old Scholomance, follow the dungeon corridors through the Reliquary toward the Great Ossuary. Defeat old Rattlegore below the ossuary and loot the Viewing Room Key if the Viewing Room door is locked; return upstairs and open that door.

recovery.text: The modern and original Rattlegores are different encounters. If the door is already open, use it. Do not clear all six final study rooms merely to reach the journal.

nodes.writtenDestination: Memory of Scholomance: follow the Reliquary corridors to the Great Ossuary. Descend into the bone pit for old Rattlegore and the key, then return upstairs to the Viewing Room door.

nodes.text: Inside the old Viewing Room, look behind Marduk Blackpool at the second bookcase from the left wall. Loot the small horizontal Familiar Journal from the upper shelf, partly obscured by other books.

recovery.text: This is the original dungeon’s Familiar Journal, not Eva’s ritual journal from the modern dungeon. Circle behind the shelf and inspect carefully; receiving or using Eva’s book does not grant this toy.

nodes.writtenDestination: Old Scholomance Viewing Room: behind Marduk Blackpool, inspect the second bookcase from the left wall. The small horizontal journal is partly hidden on an upper shelf.

lineage.description:
This is an event-triggered dungeon with the following steps:

1. Talk to Erozion at the beginning of the dungeon to obtain a Pack of Incendiary Bombs.

2. Traverse to the internment camps in Durnholde Keep and interact with a barrel in each building to start a fire and summon the first boss Lieutenant Drake.

3. Find Thrall in the basement of the keep and follow him for the remainder of the dungeon.

destination.label: Lorewalker Han at the Seat of Knowledge
destination.directions: Inside the upper Seat of Knowledge above Mogu’shan Palace. Use a supported current route to the upper building.

instructions: Speak to Lorewalker Han in the upper Seat of Knowledge. Choose the Forgotten Depths beneath the Isle of Thunder.
The solo legacy queue places you by the Tortos section. It is a separate Raid Finder loot opportunity; it does not require clearing Jin’rokh, Horridon or Council of Elders first.
If Han is phased out, use the available time-phase dialogue in the Vale and inspect his actual menu. Do not infer an offered queue or a flight unlock from level.

subguides.title: All gates to the Nighthold roof
instructions: Follow the aqueduct route to Skorpyron. Defeat him, sheltering behind the crystal fragments for Shockwave if the encounter lasts long enough.
Continue along the aqueduct into the Chronomatic Anomaly chamber. If Power Overwhelming blocks progress, kill a Waning Time Particle, take its Temporal Charge and use Temporal Smash on the boss.
Follow the adjoining passage into Trilliax’s room. Defeat the construct, move with the Annihilation beam and clear required room hazards before using the way onward.

In the central royal area, find Spellblade Aluriel’s patrol and defeat her. Keep the ice/fire/arcane marks away from other players until their indicated interaction is needed; handle the animated enchantments.
Take the route up Astromancer’s Rise into the Eternal Observatory for Star Augur Etraeus. Complete his changing celestial phases; handle the summoned void creature when it protects him.
Return to the royal area and take the Shal’dorei Terrace branch to High Botanist Tel’arn. Defeat the split forms, kill parasitic adds and leave the expanding Controlled Chaos circles.

Return to the central area and take the southeast Shattered Walkway to Krosus. Stay off the Fel Beam side, handle Slam circles with your group and move back from each bridge section before it collapses.

Backtrack to the Captain’s Quarters in the southwest and defeat Tichondrius. Shelter behind Fel Spires during Echoes of the Void; in his night phase kill bats and avoid the incoming nightmare attacks.

After all eight earlier bosses are defeated, use the newly accessible Nightspire route. Speak to the available Image of Khadgar/teleport control where needed and enter Elisande’s chamber. Complete her time rewinds; cross Arcanetic Rings through the slowed sections near the time zones.
subguides.branchSemantics: First three linear; the central five may be completed in another valid order; all eight must finish before Elisande, then Gul’dan. No four-kill skip quest is required.
